Port and train spawning\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine/src/execution/PortExecution.ts\n\nPortExecution.ts and TrainStationExecution.ts (packages/engine/src/execution/) implement port/train spawning: a port spawns a TrainStationExecution when a Factory is within trainStationMaxRange, and the station spawns trains on a 10-tick cooldown if its rail cluster has a trade destination.\n\n```typescript\n  createStation(): void {\n    const nearbyFactory = this.mg.hasUnitNearby(\n      this.port.tile()!,\n      this.mg.config().trainStationMaxRange(),\n      UnitType.Factory,\n    );\n    if (nearbyFactory) {\n      this.mg.addExecution(new TrainStationExecution(this.port));\n    }\n  }\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Nation nuke targeting\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine/src/execution/nation/NationNukeBehavior.ts\n\nNationNukeBehavior.ts (packages/engine/src/execution/nation/) is the AI nation's nuke targeting engine: maybeSendNuke() gates on MissileSilo availability, selects a target, enumerates nuke types (Hydrogen first, Atom on Hard/Impossible), and picks the best tile via findBestNukeTile() for each candidate.\n\n```typescript\n  maybeSendNuke() {\n    const silos = this.player.units(UnitType.MissileSilo);\n    const config = this.game.config();\n    if (\n      silos.length === 0 ||\n      config.isUnitDisabled(UnitType.MissileSilo) ||\n      (config.isUnitDisabled(UnitType.AtomBomb) &&\n        config.isUnitDisabled(UnitType.HydrogenBomb))\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const choice = this.chooseNukeTarget();\n    if (choice === null) {\n      return;\n    }\n    const { target: nukeTarget, strike } = choice;\n\n    if (\n      nukeTarget.type() === PlayerType.Bot || // Don't nuke tribes (as opposed to nations and humans)\n      this.player.isOnSameTeam(nukeTarget) ||\n      this.attackBehavior.shouldAttack(nukeTarget) === false\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // While saving up for a MIRV, Hard & Impossible only nuke back at players hitting them, with atom bombs\n    const saving = this.isSavingForMirv();\n    if (saving && !this.isHittingUs(nukeTarget)) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const nukeTypes = this.nukeTypesToTry(saving);\n    if (nukeTypes.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const structures = nukeTarget.units(Structures.types);\n    const difficulty = this.game.config().gameConfig().difficulty;\n    // Use more random tiles on Impossible difficulty to improve chances of finding a perfect SAM outranging spot\n    const numRandomTiles = difficulty === Difficulty.Impossible ? 30 : 10;\n    const randomTiles = randTerritoryTileArray(\n      this.random,\n      this.game,\n      nukeTarget,\n      numRandomTiles,\n    );\n    const candidates = new Set(\n      randomTiles.concat(structures.map((u) => u.tile())),\n    );\n    this.removeOldNukeEvents();\n\n    for (const nukeType of nukeTypes) {\n      const tile = this.findBestNukeTile(\n        nukeType,\n        nukeTarget,\n        candidates,\n        silos,\n        structures,\n        strike,\n      );\n      if (tile !== null) {\n        this.sendNuke(tile, nukeType, nukeTarget);\n        if (strike && this.followsUpStrikes()) {\n          this.strikes.push({\n            target: nukeTarget,\n            tile,\n            tick: this.game.ticks(),\n            nuke: null,\n          });\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n    if (difficulty === Difficulty.Impossible && !saving) {\n      this.maybeDestroyEnemySam(nukeTarget);\n    }\n  }\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Generate synthetic scenarios\n\nSource:
